title: "[Type]: Short description"
labels: triage

## Issue Type

- [ ] Functional bug
- [ ] Feature enhancement
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance
- [ ] Documentation

## Description

Describe the problem or improvement clearly.

## Current Behavior

Explain what currently happens.

## Expected Behavior

Explain what should happen after the issue is resolved.

## Affected Files Or Sections

List the resource category, document, or data file affected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to this issue.
- [ ] The branch name describes the work.
- [ ] The pull request uses the project template.
- [ ] A peer review comment is added before merge.
